problem: Windows Task Scheduler state that autonomous software depends on (supervisor continuity, worker restart) is managed through hand-written schtasks subprocess calls and hand-copied XML, with recorded byte-fidelity incidents, recurring shared-staging lane blockers, and host residue.
owner_goal_alignment: IDEA.md requires continuous operation with tested releases and rollback on a Windows host; Task Scheduler is the continuity backbone (installer.py, packaging/, V7 release management). A safe declarative manager removes a recurring blocker class for every future lane.
mvp: export: snapshot live tasks under a scope folder to canonical JSON plus byte-exact XML artifacts with SHA-256, re-read-verified
validate: lint a declared JSON task set (schema, trigger/action sanity, scope guards)
plan: declared-vs-live diff gate producing create/update/delete/noop with CI exit codes and machine-readable output
apply: idempotent apply restricted to an explicit scope folder prefix, dry-run default, post-apply independent re-export verification
acceptance_criteria: AC1 export produces stable canonical JSON and XML bytes whose sha256 matches on immediate re-read
AC2 validate rejects malformed definitions with precise errors and exit 2
AC3 plan reports exactly the expected delta for staged scenarios (create/update/delete/noop) and exits 1 when drift exists in gate mode
AC4 apply creates a lab task on the real host non-elevated, verifies it independently by re-export, is idempotent (second apply = noop)
AC5 out-of-band live modification is detected by plan as update drift
AC6 delete via apply removes the task and re-export confirms absence
AC7 refusal semantics: root scope, wildcard scope, path outside prefix, missing PowerShell, access-denied each produce clear BLOCKED/error outcomes, never partial silent mutation
AC8 unit suite passes offline with an injected fake PS bridge; live integration suite passes on this host under \JarvisLab\
architecture_constraints: PowerShell CIM cmdlets over subprocess (no pywin32)
injectable process runner for deterministic tests
risk: Scheduler API differences across Windows builds; mitigation: structured CIM cmdlets instead of schtasks text parsing; live probes scoped to lab folder
test_strategy: unit tests against injected fake bridge (offline deterministic) + opt-in live integration marker TASKWARD_LIVE=1 + independent verifier script exercising AC1-AC8
rollback_deletion_path: new standalone repository; deletion of C:/temp/JARVIS-Autonomous-Project-Lab/taskward and its remote fully reverses; no JARVIS runtime coupling
maintenance_revisit_conditions: Windows build changes Task Scheduler cmdlet behavior
owner requests scheduler automation integration handoff
